title: A connector save of `retryConfig: {}` keeps a withheld key; decide whether an empty container clears it
body:
coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_6f02c340437c42c6ba85dec8d1a7c65b

Filing gate: **③ a task the maintainer assigned directly.** The maintainer said in session, verbatim: 「不用开新的云会话，如果有安全问题走专用上报通道，普通问题提交issue」.

Reader: `domain:spec`, the seat taking this from `pm:queue`. Start after #29573 lands, because this card reads its tree.

Dedupe (open AND closed), by `GET search/issues`:
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack "retryConfig" withheld clear`: 9 hits. #29573 discloses this behaviour and leaves it open; #28997, #28688 and #29456 landed the neighbouring read and save rules, and none decides this.
- `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack deleted-baseline 17356 depth`: 3 hits. #17356 is the closed origin of the pin in item 2, and none asks for the depth specimen.

## 1. An empty `retryConfig`

A save that leaves `retryConfig` out removes it, withheld keys included, and that is pinned. A save of `retryConfig: {}` over a stored row that holds a withheld key keeps that key at rest, through the protocol's per-path carry-forward. The original acceptance for this work read 「明确清除(`{}`)才删除」, so the behaviour differs from its letter. Both contract reviews on #29573 escalated this rather than ruling it (comment 6590686226, ③(b)).

Decide one of these, and pin the answer at the HTTP door:
- **A (recommended): omission is the explicit clear.** Keep the code and add a pin for `retryConfig: {}`. A served-form save loses nothing and an author already has a clear.
- **B: an empty container clears.** This changes `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s carry-forward for every type, so it needs its own declaration and pins.

## 2. A depth specimen for the #17356 pin

#29573 moves that pin's specimen in `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.deleted-baseline.test.ts` from `integration/RetryConfig` to the root's own def. The named claim still holds, but the walk's descent beneath an unregistered root is no longer measured. Keep a specimen beneath that root too: an instance-auth kind reached through `connector.auth` stays root-graph in the closed entry (S4 in the same review comment).

## Acceptance

- [ ] The ruling on item 1 is recorded here, and a dogfood pin holds that reading at `PUT /api/v1/meta/connector/:name`.
- [ ] The deleted-baseline test measures a def beneath an unregistered root again.
